name: Bulgaria
summary: White, green and red horizontal bands. First adopted in 1879 after liberation from Ottoman rule, it is often said to be modelled on the Russian tricolour, with green replacing blue.
origin: Bulgaria became an autonomous principality after the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–1878. The Constituent Assembly at Tarnovo adopted the tricolour on 16 April 1879; the design is commonly said to adapt the Russian flag, with green for the land.
The communist People's Republic added its state emblem in the canton from 1947. The emblem was removed and the plain tricolour restored on 22 November 1990.

colors.name: Green
colors.meaning: The fertility of the land and agriculture.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The courage of the people and the blood shed for independence.
